name: Tenshi no Hohoemi
source:
Desktop Collection Vol.3 "Angel smile".
Contains:
- Animated cursors
- Icons
- Wallpapers
- Windows system sound voices
- Stopwatch app
- Calendar app
- Mini game: Yukata Bijin (Mosquito Zap)
- RPG game: Mina and Riko's Fantasy Quest
- Patches to Desktop Collection Vol.1 "Tenshi no Oshigoto" and Vol.2 "Tenshi no Tsubasa"
- Voice drama with 5 chapters in the form of screensaver
